edge.label: Credential and privilege transition: successfully using the unchanged pi password provides administrator-level authenticated access on the Raspberry Pi. If RaspAP is deployed on that host and accepts the pi account or the same credentials, this satisfies the authenticated-access precondition for the virtually unrestricted includes/webconsole.php web console, after which the attacker can execute operating-system commands, upload files, and execute code.

source_node.label: Raspberry Pi OS default credential exposure through version 5.10. The pi account retains the default password when the administrator has not changed it.

source_node.postcondition: The attacker can authenticate as the pi account using the unchanged default password and gain administrator-level privileges on the Raspberry Pi, providing authenticated access and the ability to perform privileged local or remote actions.
